evidence: MODELED SELECTED DEVELOPMENT ILLUSTRATION; NOT CONFIRMATION

assessment.method: One-sided 95% Student-t lower bound over independent paired mission-cluster mean deltas, conditional on modeled observations
limitations: A small-sample t interval is an approximation for the modeled delta distribution, not a distribution-free guarantee.
The interval does not bound systematic semantic errors shared by producers and evaluators.
Forecast uses, modeled resource effects, quality and test coverage remain assumptions; actual evaluation expense is charged in both arms.
This report carries no identity, admission, retrieval, composition or execution authority.
assessment.caveat: The bound is conditional on the modeled observations. Shared semantic blind spots can invalidate an apparently positive result.

attribution.note: Resource savings are paired same-seed workflow costs, not causal revenue or complete enterprise gain. Asset-reference bills exclude shared discovery; all B is separately reported. New revenue, queue displacement, pricing, reputation, and lost jobs require whole-policy contrast.

limitations: Selected after observing the development grid; one independent world. C8Q1 and C8Q4 reuse the same seed and are not two independent replications.
The 36 fresh capacity holdouts have zero admissions and zero peer-use outcomes; this illustration does not replace them.
All jobs, receipts, capability gains and transfers are simulated, with assumed scope, quality, demand and resource effects.
A positive Alpha probe or useful peer-use job is not proof of positive realized complete asset or network return.
Whole-policy contrast includes queue displacement, changes in acquisition/price/reputation, failed work and all costs; do not clip its negative sign.
The optional research/retention policy grid is bounded and lacks a separately optimized B-only enterprise.
